ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

17. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Safety when handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Light its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Forming shadows in light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Precautions when using and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain School environment environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping Safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
